arithmetic/25: Representation: TS (float64) yields NaN for a negative base to a fractional power, recorded as error; Rust decimals have no NaN, so the result is null. They differ only where NaN is observable as a number (e.g. `is defined`).
builder/sub-process-no-callback-error: Unrepresentable: TS throws when subProcess() gets no content callback; in Rust the callback is a required closure, so the script cannot be written.
